Website Security Check

Website security review / Information use

Your review.
Your information.

Updated October 25, 2026. This notice describes the website security check and its optional email report. Contact info@archwoodinnovations.com with questions or to request access to or deletion of your submission records.

What we record

When you submit a valid website address, we record its normalized HTTPS homepage address, the time, review type, outcome, and assessment results. Failed and interrupted reviews are recorded too. We discard paths, query strings, and fragments from the address you enter. Returned page and redirect URLs can appear in assessment evidence. Inputs containing login details or unsupported addresses are rejected before recording.

We use a rotating, keyed hash of the request’s network address to limit abuse. Our application does not store the raw network address in its lead database. Hosting providers may retain their own access and security logs.

Optional email report

If you request a report link, we record your email address, associated review, request time, optional request for contact, email submission status, and whether the private report link has been opened. Opening the link unlocks the report and expanded review. An email address alone does not establish ownership of the tested website.

The report request and email address are available to Archwood’s team. When the report link is opened, we may send our team a separate notification containing the website, your email address, initial summary, and whether you requested help. We do not put your private access link in that notification.

How we use the information

We use these records to provide reports, operate and improve the review service, limit abuse, understand demand, and respond to requested help. An email report request is not an automatic marketing subscription. The optional contact checkbox asks for follow-up about the review only.

Service providers and retention

The service runs on Vercel. Supabase stores submission and lead records. Resend processes the email address and report-link email. These providers process information as needed to operate their services and may retain operational logs under their own policies.

Private report links expire after seven days. Detailed report content and quick-check receipt credentials are removed after fourteen days. Submission summaries, website records, email requests, and associated lead records are retained for up to ninety days, with a scheduled daily cleanup. Repeat requests can create newer records with their own retention periods. Provider backups and logs may have different retention periods.

Keep private links private

Anyone with a valid emailed report link can open that report until the link expires. Do not post it publicly. No advertising or analytics scripts are included on the report page.

Assessment scope

The tool provides an initial passive public review, not a penetration test, security certification, guarantee, or confirmation of compromise. Results can miss vulnerabilities or flag items that do not apply. Your host or an authorized security professional should verify the findings before making decisions.
